report.title: Taxon attribute definitions for tanhub
report.description: Validate configured attributes even when the taxa report returns no rows.
report.query: SELECT #columns# FROM taxa_taxon_list_attributes a WHERE a.deleted=false AND a.id=ANY(ARRAY[#taxon_attribute_ids#]::integer[])

column.name: taxon_attributes
column.sql: json_build_object('version', 1, 'attributes', COALESCE(json_agg( json_build_object('id', a.id, 'data_type', a.data_type, 'multi_value', a.multi_value, 'termlist_id', a.termlist_id, 'values', '[]'::json) ORDER BY a.id), '[]'::json))
